title: CONTEXT -- how served text is costed, and the kit's default ceiling for each measure
description: The estimator that turns bytes into tokens and the DEFAULT ceiling of every context measure (`always_loaded_tokens`, `indexed_tokens`, `activated_body_tokens`, `on_demand_page_tokens`, published by the context gate). A default binds only a measure the host has not budgeted in its corpus map; a host's row is its own number, held by the ratchet. The defaults are tight on purpose: the always-loaded layer carries laws and pointers, and everything else is read on demand (ADR-024).

inline_limit_tokens.description: An inlined section above this is reported as one a pointer would carry.
